nodes.summary: There exist a prime $p$ and a finite $p$-group $G$ such that for every finite $p$-group $H$, the Frattini subgroup $\Phi(H)$ of $H$ is not isomorphic to the derived subgroup $[G, G]$ of $G$. That is, the conjecture of Kourovka Problem 16.11 is false.
nodes.title: Derived subgroups of p-groups need not be Frattini subgroups of p-groups

nodes.summary: The conjecture of Ya. G. Berkovich that for every prime $p$ and every finite $p$-group $G$ there is a finite $p$-group $H$ whose Frattini subgroup $\Phi(H)$, the intersection of the maximal subgroups of $H$, is isomorphic to the derived subgroup $[G, G]$ of $G$.
nodes.title: Derived subgroups of p-groups as Frattini subgroups (Kourovka 16.11)
